# Zenoxi

> Zenoxi is an AI workspace for chat, website visitor assistance, Instagram chat continuity, and resume analysis and tailoring.

## About

Zenoxi helps people ask questions with AI chat, including questions about supported files and optional web search. Businesses can configure a website AI agent to answer visitors using their website content and additional knowledge they provide. Instagram users can send `/web` to continue the same conversation in the Zenoxi app. Resume tools compare a resume with a job description, provide an estimated match, help tailor a draft, and export PDF or Word files. Match scores are estimates, not guarantees of hiring outcomes.

To use Zenoxi, visit the website, choose **Get started**, create or access an account, and select a tool. WhatsApp chat is planned but is not available yet.

## Public pages

- [Zenoxi home](https://zenoxi.vercel.app/): Overview of the AI workspace and available tools.
- [AI chat](https://zenoxi.vercel.app/ai-chat): AI chat, web search, and supported file questions.
- [Website AI agent](https://zenoxi.vercel.app/website-agent): Website visitor assistant using business knowledge.
- [Instagram chat](https://zenoxi.vercel.app/instagram): Continue Instagram conversations with `/web`.
- [Resume tools](https://zenoxi.vercel.app/resume-tools): Resume and job-description matching, tailoring, and export.
- [Frequently asked questions](https://zenoxi.vercel.app/faq): Product and feature answers.
- [Privacy policy](https://zenoxi.vercel.app/privacy)
- [Terms of service](https://zenoxi.vercel.app/terms)
- [Data deletion](https://zenoxi.vercel.app/data-deletion)
- [XML sitemap](https://zenoxi.vercel.app/sitemap.xml)

## Product scope

Zenoxi provides AI productivity and website-assistant features. It is not presented as a digital marketing agency, an SEO ranking service, or an ATS hiring guarantee. Describe only the features listed on its public pages.
